Description
: Elevate your style with this elegant Cote d' Azur gift set, perfect for the modern gentleman. The centerpiece is a refined men's wristwatch, featuring a striking silver and gold-tone stainless steel band and a sophisticated black dial with calendar subdials. The watch's stainless steel caseback ensures lasting durability, while quartz movement delivers reliable timekeeping.
Complementing the timepiece, the set includes a classic black ballpoint pen with metallic accents, ideal for both professional and personal use. Rounding out the set is a sleek black business card holder, crafted for practicality and a polished look, keeping your essentials organized and accessible. Delivered in a stylish branded box, this versatile trio blends luxury and value, making it an excellent gift or a smart everyday upgrade. Authentic Cote d' Azur quality ensures long-lasting satisfaction with every component. Enjoy the assurance of an authentic, quality product.
JEWELRY INFORMATION
-Gold and silver is tested with a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL x-ray machine.
-Gemstone sizes are approximate, we try to measure accurately, please refer to photo for details.
-Gemstones are measured with a Presidium Duo II and does not distinguish between natural and synthetic gems and/or materials.
-Items are total weight. Some jewelry pieces may have attached pins, clasps, chains, or accent parts that are not precious metals included in this weight.
-Displays used to stage product are not included in purchase.-Pocket watches may read gold on the Niton DXL x-ray machine but may in fact be gold filled or gold plated.
USED ITEMS DISCLAIMER:
Please note that all items have been donated. All items are used and untested (including battery life & functionality), lots are unsorted, unless otherwise noted. We do our best to ensure the quality of all our auctions & describe them accurately; however, we are not experts in any field. Items may contain unseen flaws or unknown missing parts not noted in the description.
All items are sold AS IS.
If you need further information about an item, please contact us prior to the close of the auction.
TERMS OF SALE:
Orders must be paid for within seven (7) days from the close of auction. All orders not paid within ten (10) days from the close of auction will be relisted for auction without further notice. Displays used to stage product are not included in purchase. Auctions cannot be combined if listed as such under Shipping tab.
AUTHENTICATION:
We do not authenticate or appraise auction items, unless otherwise indicated in auction description or photographs.

Description
: Explore the fascinating world of geology with this premium collection of natural stones and crystals, perfect for education, study, or display. This set includes an array of tumbled gemstones, polished fossil stones, unique geode candle holders (one amethyst), and natural minerals, each selected for its eye-catching colors, patterns, and textures. Individual items include fossil coral stones, polished river rocks, a hand-carved gemstone dodecahedron, natural seashells, and various tumbled crystal varieties such as quartz, jasper, and agate. The geode candleholders make striking decorative pieces and conversation starters. Ideal for classrooms, collectors, or home decor enthusiasts, these specimens highlight the beauty and diversity of Earth's natural treasures. Every piece in this assortment has been carefully chosen for authenticity and quality, ensuring a unique addition to your collection. Add natural charm to your learning or living space, and shop confidentlythese stones and crystals are sustainably sourced and handled with care.
